messages:
Priya Menon: Heads-up  onsite tomorrow AM candidate will bring a service dog and needs a quiet private space to sign an NDA. Need security, facilities, and legal sign-off for on-site animal access + temporary paperwork station. Also request for a printed NDA and a small outdoor relief route.

Evelyn Park: Candidate name + ETA? Any medical documentation needed?

Priya Menon: Candidate: Noor Hassan, +1-646-555-0166. ETA 09:20, arriving via BART. Noor has a certified service dog, no special medical docs required beyond standard ID. Wants a printed NDA to sign on arrival and a charger port nearby.

Legal Intake Bot: Legal approves paper NDA signing on-site. Please ensure the NDA version is v2025-04-NDA. We'll need the signed copy scanned and uploaded to candidate-file@redwood.com within 2 hours.

Facilities Bot: Quiet Private Room E (1st floor) reserved 09:1011:00. We'll leave a small folding table for paperwork, a chair, and a power strip by 09:05. Outside relief route: West courtyard path and disabled-access gate unlocked at 09:15. Signage for service animal path placed.

Security Desk: Badge pre-print under "Noor Hassan." Please ask Noor to present ID at lobby; we'll escort them and the service dog up to Room E. Service dog access noted in visitor logs. Parking: no permit needed if using BART; if they drive, we'll provide a one-day P3 permit.

Priya Menon: Can Cafe Team prepare a vegan snack (no nuts) and bottled water left in Room E? Also please ensure packaging is low-fragrance.

Cafe Team: Vegan snack (hummus + veggie cup, no nuts) and bottled water confirmed, low-fragrance packaging. Delivery at 09:05.

Evelyn Park: Run-of-day (short):
```
09:20  Candidate arrival / ID & badge (Security)
09:30  NDA signing + quick intro (10m)
09:40  Panel interviews start (3x30m)
11:20  Wrap + candidate questions
11:30  Candidate leaves / scan & upload NDA
```

Priya Menon: Thank you all. @Security Desk please text me when badge is printed and when escort departs lobby. @Legal Intake Bot please confirm the upload mailbox received the final PDF. Noor's cell again +1-646-555-0166. :pray:
